note: Coordinates from OpenStreetMap (Nominatim) and the DWR station record; approximate to the block. Kinds: park, trail, landmark. Business pins come from businesses.json.

places.name: Main Street
places.blurb: Six blocks of sandstone storefronts between the two highway junctions.

places.name: Sandstone Park & the visitor center
places.blurb: The downtown green at 4th and Broadway: visitor center, concert lawn, the Depot.

places.name: LaVern M. Johnson Park
places.blurb: The whitewater park, splash pad, campground and winter ice rink, under the cliffs off Broadway.

places.name: Bohn Park
places.blurb: Ball fields, the dog park, an accessible fishing platform, the bike park and the river trail.

places.name: St. Vrain Trailhead (2nd Ave)
places.blurb: Trail access on the south bank and dry campervan parking in season.

places.name: Hall Ranch (Bitterbrush trailhead)
places.blurb: Boulder County open space: 13.6 miles of trail, the Bitterbrush climb and the Nelson Loop. No dogs.

places.name: Heil Valley Ranch
places.blurb: 19 miles of trail south of town; the Picture Rock trail links it to Lyons. No dogs, no e-bikes.

places.name: Ron Stewart Preserve at Rabbit Mountain
places.blurb: The dry, early-season hike north-east of town; leashed dogs welcome.

places.name: Button Rock Preserve
places.blurb: Longmont's watershed preserve up County Road 80: the Sleepy Lion trail and the walk to the dam. Foot travel only, no dogs.

places.name: Apple Valley Road bridge
places.blurb: The wooden arch over the North St. Vrain, a tubing put-in when the water is right.

places.name: St. Vrain gauge (SVCLYOCO)
places.blurb: The state streamflow gauge below the confluence; the number on the river page comes from here.

places.name: Planet Bluegrass
places.blurb: The festival ranch on the river at the west end of Main.

places.name: Lyons Redstone Museum
places.blurb: Town history in the 1881 sandstone schoolhouse on High Street.

places.name: Old Stone Church
places.blurb: The 1894 sandstone church at 4th and High, on the National Register.

places.name: The Lyons Depot
places.blurb: The 1885 railroad depot beside Sandstone Park.

places.name: Lyons Regional Library
places.blurb: 451 4th Avenue: programs, meeting rooms and public restrooms.

places.name: Lyons Town Hall
places.blurb: 432 5th Avenue: the Board meets here on first and third Mondays.

places.name: West junction: US 36 / CO 7
places.blurb: Left for Colorado 7 and Allenspark, right for US 36 and Estes Park.

places.name: East junction: US 36 / CO 66
places.blurb: Where the Longmont road meets Main Street.
